P1.name: The Busy Parent
P1.who: Two working parents, two kids under ten, cooking dinner five nights a week.
P1.jtbd: Get dinner on the table in 30 minutes without a grocery run, with food the kids will eat.
P1.objections: Too expensive per serving. Too much packaging. Will the kids actually eat this?
P1.converts_on: Clear per-serving price, kid-friendly filters, an easy skip-a-week, a first-box discount that doesn't hide the real price.

P2.name: The Home Cook
P2.who: Single or couple, cooks for fun, reads ingredient lists.
P2.jtbd: Try new cuisines and techniques without buying a whole bottle of a spice used once.
P2.objections: Recipes are too basic. Ingredient quality. Portion sizes for two.
P2.converts_on: Recipe depth, sourcing detail, a menu that changes enough week to week, flexible plan sizes.
